description: Structured error body returned by all proxy endpoints on failure. NEVER contains API key material, request bodies, or response bodies.

metadata.model_not_enabled: HTTP 403; the request named a model that is not allowed AND enabled. The lockdown refusal - a misbehaving harness cannot escalate to non-approved models.
metadata.service_disabled: HTTP 403; the request named a service whose key is absent from the environment or that the operator disabled.
metadata.forbidden: HTTP 403; the request did not match any permitted route/method.
metadata.upstream_error: HTTP 502; the upstream provider returned an error. The message summarises the upstream status ONLY; upstream bodies are not relayed.
metadata.message_rule: messages are for operators reading logs/terminals, are safe to show a harness, and MUST be treated as untrusted input by the harness.
